# `restore_factory_calib_frame`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Remove the customer calibration library and reload the factory calibration.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (D64 and D32 command-socket invocation) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, restore_factory_calib_frame @0xdcc70, RestoreCustomerCalib @0x3bdd80 (reloads @0x3bdfa8, @0x3bdfb0, @0x3be004) (64-bit build) |

Refused with 524 first if a View function, ViewPlan, planet stack, batch stack or mount-occupying function is active. Then deletes the customer library files, clears an in-memory dark-library lookup table and one calibration image buffer, and reloads bias, flat_IR and (wheel models) flat_LP from disk. A missing customer directory is not an error. There is no rollback after a partial removal failure.

Side effects: Deletes customer calibration files, clears a dark-library lookup table and one image buffer, reloads bias and flat from disk. Synchronous filesystem work with no explicit timeout. Every full call also makes the shared diagnostic log writes.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"restore_factory_calib_frame"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | no | - | Optional object; absent, null, scalar, array or malformed members use defaults. No positional form. Unknown keys ignored. [READ] |
| `params.wide_cam` | boolean\|integer | no | false | Target the wide camera. A wrong type is treated as false. true requires wide star view support (210); the request is relayed to the peer process. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 524 | A View function, ViewPlan, planet stack, batch stack or mount-occupying function is active; checked before parsing | `function conflict` |
| 210 | wide_cam requested but the model does not support wide star view | `not supported` |
| 218 | A customer file could not be removed | `fail to write file` |
| 300 | Relay with no caller context | `internal error` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Relay forwarding errors are possible, with potentially duplicated error fragments; peer-process reply handling is unresolved. The app sends this request with no params.

## Example

Request, restore:

```json
{"id":54,"method":"restore_factory_calib_frame"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"restore_factory_calib_frame","result":{"value":1},"code":0,"id":54}
```

Reply, conflict:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"restore_factory_calib_frame","error":"function conflict","code":524,"id":55}
```
